hero.title: Why PointOak?
hero.subtitle: Sophisticated Advice. Straightforward Guidance. A Team That Knows You.

blocks.text: Choosing an adviser involves more than investment performance. You should understand who is advising you, how they are compensated, the standard that applies to the relationship, how they approach investments and planning, and whether you can reach the people responsible for your advice.
PointOak combines the independence and personal attention of a boutique advisory firm with deep experience across private wealth management and employer-sponsored retirement plans.

sections.title: 1. Your Adviser Should Work for You

blocks.text: PointOak is an independent, fee-only fiduciary wealth advisory firm. As an SEC-registered investment adviser, PointOak is required to act in its advisory clients’ best interests and put their interests ahead of its own. We do not receive investment-product commissions or operate a proprietary investment lineup. For retirement plans, PointOak can provide 3(21) investment fiduciary services, where the sponsor or committee retains final decision-making authority, or 3(38) investment manager services, where PointOak exercises delegated investment discretion within the agreed scope.

PointOak is not owned by an investment-product manufacturer and is not limited to a proprietary fund family. For private wealth clients, we can evaluate a broad universe of investments and strategies. For retirement plans, we can evaluate investments, recordkeepers, providers, and other solutions without a proprietary lineup.

sections.title: 3. Investment Management and Financial Planning Belong Together

blocks.text: We coordinate retirement goals, cash flow and income needs, tax considerations, 401(k)s and workplace benefits, Social Security and pensions, executive compensation, estate considerations, and family and legacy goals alongside investment management.

sections.title: 4. We Bring Experience From Both Sides of Retirement

blocks.text: Founder Darsh Makim, CRPC®, has advised retirement plan sponsors and individual clients since 2005. That employer-plan experience provides additional perspective on investments, workplace benefits, fiduciary oversight, plan features, participant decisions, and the transition from workplace retirement assets to personal wealth.

sections.title: 5. Complex Advice Should Still Be Understandable

blocks.text: We explain recommendations, tradeoffs, and practical next steps in plain language.

sections.title: 6. You Should Be Able to Reach Your Adviser

blocks.text: PointOak clients work directly with experienced advisers who know their circumstances. When appropriate, we also coordinate with CPAs, estate attorneys, and other professionals.

body.text: Different advisory models can provide valuable services, and the right relationship depends on what a client is looking for. PointOak's structure is designed to provide fiduciary advice, fee-only compensation, open-architecture investment management, and direct access to experienced advisers within an independently owned firm. That's the distinction we want prospects to understand.

sections.title: 7. Boutique Service Without a Narrow Perspective

blocks.text: The goal isn't to be the largest advisory firm. It's to provide clients with experienced advice, broad capabilities, and a relationship where their adviser actually knows them.
